snippet.title: Maneki Mania Land: Clicker Park | Early Access Trailer (December 3)
snippet.description:
Pet the lucky cat. Build the festival. Make it rain koban.

A lucky cat runs a Japanese summer festival, and you are its new manager. Build the park lot by lot, then step up and play every machine yourself: claw, koi pond, pachinko, Daruma wheel and the giant Maneki Grand Slot. 11 playable machines, 31 languages, no microtransactions.

Early Access on Steam, December 3. Wishlist now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4931850/

Web: https://lianes8studio.com/maneki
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/JHWmhHjbnd
